notes.title: Patch v1.12 - Twin Pistols!
notes.content:
Hello again,

Version 1.12 is now available bringing the following updates:

- Twin Pistols
- One Button "Easy Reloading"

I introduced the Easy Reloading feature as some people were having some trouble with the standard mechanics and it also plays much better in Twin Pistol mode with easier reloading.

Let me know what you think.

notes.title: Patch v1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The rotation of the gun has been changed to feel more natural.

A number of players commented on how the gun was angled down when they were holding it in a way that felt naturally level.

Let me know if you like it better this way.

Thanks!
